rules.en: The bill bill date is today.
The bill item price is medicine.price.
The medicine qty is medicine.qty - bill_item.qty.
The bill item amount is bill_item.qty * bill_item.price.
The bill subtotal is sum(items, x => x.amount).
The bill discount is if bill.subtotal > 5000 then trunc(bill.subtotal * 0.1, 2) else 0.
The bill gst is trunc((bill.subtotal - bill.discount) * 0.17, 2).
The bill total is bill.subtotal - bill.discount + bill.gst.
